iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MissingDocsNotice" name="Missing documents notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupportingDocuments" name="Supporting documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AcceptanceLetter" name="Acceptance letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RejectionLetter" name="Rejection letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation" name="Enrollment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrientationMaterials" name="Orientation materials"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Enrollment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_University" name="University" processRef="Process_University"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Prospective student / student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Student_SubmitApplication" targetRef="University_ReceiveApplication" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MissingNotice" name="Missing documents notice" sourceRef="University_SendMissingNotice" targetRef="Student_ReceiveMissingNotice" messageRef="Message_MissingDocsNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupportingDocuments" name="Provide missing documents" sourceRef="Student_SendDocuments" targetRef="University_ReceiveDocuments" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance letter" sourceRef="University_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Student_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptanceLetter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection letter" sourceRef="University_SendRejection" targetRef="Student_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectionLetter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Enrollment confirmation" sourceRef="Student_SendConfirmation" targetRef="University_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Orientation" name="Orientation materials" sourceRef="University_SendOrientation" targetRef="Student_ReceiveOrientation" messageRef="Message_OrientationMaterials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_University" name="University enrollment processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="University_LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ReceiveApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_DocumentsComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_SendMissingNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ReceiveDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_AcceptanceDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ConfirmationGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ConfirmationDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_CancelledEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_InternationalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_InternationalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_OnboardingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_OnboardedEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_SendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_RejectedEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsCommittee" name="Admissions committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_ProcessFees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_FeesEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International student office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_AssistVisa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>University_SetUpAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="University_Start" name="Begin application processing"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="University_ReceiveApplication" name="Receive online application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="University_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="University_DocumentsComplete" name="Are all documents present?" default="University_Flow_DocumentsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="University_SendMissingNotice" name="Notify applicant of missing items" messageRef="Message_MissingDocsNotice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="University_ReceiveDocuments" name="Receive missing documents" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="University_ParallelSplit" name="Run evaluation and fee processing concurrently" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="University_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="University_AcceptanceDecision" name="Is the application accepted?" default="University_Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="University_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter" messageRef="Message_AcceptanceLetter"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="University_ConfirmationGateway" name="Wait for confirmation or deadline" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="University_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive enrollment confirmation" messageRef="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="University_ConfirmationDeadline" name="Confirmation deadline">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="University_DeadlineTimer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="University_CancelledEnd" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="University_InternationalDecision" name="Is the student international?" default="University_Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="University_AssistVisa" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="University_InternationalMerge" name="Continue onboarding" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="University_OnboardingSplit" name="Provide materials and set up accounts concurrently" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="University_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials" messageRef="Message_OrientationMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="University_SetUpAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal, and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="University_OnboardingJoin" name="Complete onboarding" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="University_OnboardedEnd" name="University onboarding complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="University_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter" messageRef="Message_RejectionLetter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="University_RejectedEnd" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="University_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="University_FeesEnd" name="Fee or waiver processing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_1" sourceRef="University_Start" targetRef="University_ReceiveApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_2" sourceRef="University_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="University_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_3" sourceRef="University_ReviewApplication" targetRef="University_DocumentsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Missing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="University_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="University_SendMissingNotice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsComplete == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_DocumentsComplete" name="All documents received" sourceRef="University_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="University_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_NoticeToReceive" sourceRef="University_SendMissingNotice" targetRef="University_ReceiveDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_ReceiveToReview" sourceRef="University_ReceiveDocuments" targetRef="University_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_ToEvaluation" sourceRef="University_ParallelSplit" targetRef="University_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_ToFinance" sourceRef="University_ParallelSplit" targetRef="University_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_EvaluateDecision" sourceRef="University_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="University_AcceptanceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="University_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="University_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Rejected" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="University_AcceptanceDecision" targetRef="University_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_SendAcceptanceToGateway" sourceRef="University_SendAcceptance" targetRef="University_ConfirmationGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Confirmed" sourceRef="University_ConfirmationGateway" targetRef="University_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Deadline" sourceRef="University_ConfirmationGateway" targetRef="University_ConfirmationDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_DeadlineCancel" sourceRef="University_ConfirmationDeadline" targetRef="University_CancelledEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_ConfirmationToInternational" sourceRef="University_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="University_InternationalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_International" name="International student" sourceRef="University_InternationalDecision" targetRef="University_AssistVisa">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isInternational == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_NotInternational" name="Not international" sourceRef="University_InternationalDecision" targetRef="University_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_VisaToMerge" sourceRef="University_AssistVisa" targetRef="University_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_InternationalToSplit" sourceRef="University_InternationalMerge" targetRef="University_OnboardingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Orientation" sourceRef="University_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="University_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_Accounts" sourceRef="University_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="University_SetUpAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_OrientationJoin" sourceRef="University_SendOrientation" targetRef="University_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_AccountsJoin" sourceRef="University_SetUpAccounts" targetRef="University_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_OnboardingEnd" sourceRef="University_OnboardingJoin" targetRef="University_OnboardedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_RejectionEnd" sourceRef="University_SendRejection" targetRef="University_RejectedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="University_Flow_FinanceEnd" sourceRef="University_ProcessFees" targetRef="University_FeesEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student enrollment and semester progression" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Student_Start" name="Prospective student begins application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Student_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway" name="Wait for application response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Student_ReceiveMissingNotice" name="Receive missing documents notice" messageRef="Message_MissingDocsNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Student_SendDocuments" name="Provide missing items" messageRef="Message_SupportingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Student_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance letter" messageRef="Message_AcceptanceLetter"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Student_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection letter" messageRef="Message_RejectionLetter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Student_RejectedEnd" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_ConfirmDecision" name="Confirm enrollment by the deadline?" default="Student_Flow_NoConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Student_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm enrollment" messageRef="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Student_NoConfirmationEnd" name="Enrollment not confirmed by deadline"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Student_ReceiveOrientation" name="Receive orientation materials" messageRef="Message_OrientationMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_GetID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with an academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_AttendClasses" name="Begin attending classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_AddDropDecision" name="Add or drop courses during the add/drop period?" default="Student_Flow_SkipAddDrop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses within the add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_AddDropMerge" name="Continue semester" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_CompleteSemester" name="Reach the end of the semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_PostGrades" name="Grades are posted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Student_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_GrievanceDecision" name="Does the student have a grievance?" default="Student_Flow_NoGrievance"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Student_Appeal" name="File an appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Appeal_Start" name="Begin appeal"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Appeal_SubmitForm" name="Submit appeal form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Appeal_MeetCommittee" name="Meet with the appeals committee"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Appeal_AwaitDecision" name="Await appeal decision"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Appeal_End" name="Appeal decision received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Appeal_Flow_1" sourceRef="Appeal_Start" targetRef="Appeal_SubmitForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Appeal_Flow_2" sourceRef="Appeal_SubmitForm" targetRef="Appeal_MeetCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Appeal_Flow_3" sourceRef="Appeal_MeetCommittee" targetRef="Appeal_AwaitDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Appeal_Flow_4" sourceRef="Appeal_AwaitDecision" targetRef="Appeal_End"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_GrievanceMerge" name="Continue after grievance check" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Student_ProgressDecision" name="Graduate, withdraw, or continue?" default="Student_Flow_Continue"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Student_GraduatedEnd" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Student_WithdrawnEnd" name="Student withdraws"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_1" sourceRef="Student_Start" targetRef="Student_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_2" sourceRef="Student_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ResponseMissing" sourceRef="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway" targetRef="Student_ReceiveMissingNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ResponseAccepted" sourceRef="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway" targetRef="Student_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ResponseRejected" sourceRef="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway" targetRef="Student_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_MissingToSend" sourceRef="Student_ReceiveMissingNotice" targetRef="Student_SendDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_DocumentsToGateway" sourceRef="Student_SendDocuments" targetRef="Student_ApplicationResponseGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_RejectionEnd" sourceRef="Student_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="Student_RejectedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_AcceptanceDecision" sourceRef="Student_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Student_ConfirmDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Student_ConfirmDecision" targetRef="Student_SendConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${confirmByDeadline == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_NoConfirmation" name="Do not confirm by deadline" sourceRef="Student_ConfirmDecision" targetRef="Student_NoConfirmationEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ConfirmationToOrientation" sourceRef="Student_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Student_ReceiveOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_OrientationToID" sourceRef="Student_ReceiveOrientation" targetRef="Student_GetID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_IDToAdvisor" sourceRef="Student_GetID" targetRef="Student_MeetAdvisor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_AdvisorToCourses" sourceRef="Student_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Student_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_CoursesToConflicts" sourceRef="Student_SelectCourses" targetRef="Student_ResolveConflicts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ConflictsToClasses" sourceRef="Student_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="Student_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ClassesToAddDrop" sourceRef="Student_AttendClasses" targetRef="Student_AddDropDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_DoAddDrop" name="Add or drop courses" sourceRef="Student_AddDropDecision" targetRef="Student_AddDropCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addOrDropCourses == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_SkipAddDrop" name="No add/drop" sourceRef="Student_AddDropDecision" targetRef="Student_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_AddDropMerge" sourceRef="Student_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Student_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ToSemesterEnd" sourceRef="Student_AddDropMerge" targetRef="Student_CompleteSemester"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_PostGrades" sourceRef="Student_CompleteSemester" targetRef="Student_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ReviewGrades" sourceRef="Student_PostGrades" targetRef="Student_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_GrievanceDecision" sourceRef="Student_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Student_GrievanceDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_HasGrievance" name="Has grievance" sourceRef="Student_GrievanceDecision" targetRef="Student_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasGrievance == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_NoGrievance" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Student_GrievanceDecision" targetRef="Student_GrievanceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_AppealMerge" sourceRef="Student_Appeal" targetRef="Student_GrievanceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_ToProgressDecision" sourceRef="Student_GrievanceMerge" targetRef="Student_ProgressDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_Graduate" name="Graduate" sourceRef="Student_ProgressDecision" targetRef="Student_GraduatedEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${graduated == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_Withdraw" name="Withdraw" sourceRef="Student_ProgressDecision" targetRef="Student_WithdrawnEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${withdrawn == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Student_Flow_Continue" name="Continue to another semester" sourceRef="Student_ProgressDecision" targetRef="Student_MeetAdvisor"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
